title: Paris Travel Guide
summary: Paris blends monumental art, world-class gastronomy, and historic architecture with neighborhood warmth. From the summit of the Eiffel Tower and the treasures of the Louvre to charming sidewalk bistros along the Seine, Paris offers an unforgettable European escape.
bestTime: April to June (Spring) and September to October (Autumn) for pleasant 18°C–22°C temperatures and bustling sidewalk cafés. December brings magical Christmas illuminations along the Champs-Élysées.

quickFacts.Language: French (English widely spoken across hotels and major attractions)

attractions.name: Eiffel Tower & Champ de Mars
attractions.summary: Ascend to the summit for sweeping 360-degree city views. Book timed sunset tickets or capture iconic photos from Trocadéro Gardens across the Seine.

attractions.name: Louvre Museum & Pyramide
attractions.summary: The world's largest art museum, home to the Mona Lisa, Winged Victory of Samothrace, and Venus de Milo. Reserve advance skip-the-line timed entry.

attractions.name: Musée d'Orsay
attractions.summary: Housed in a grand Beaux-Arts railway station, showcasing legendary Impressionist masterpieces by Monet, Van Gogh, Renoir, and Degas.

attractions.name: Montmartre & Sacré-Cœur Basilica
attractions.summary: A hilltop bohemian village featuring winding cobblestone alleys, Place du Tertre portrait artists, and panoramic city vistas from the basilica steps.

attractions.name: Seine River Evening Cruise
attractions.summary: Glide past illuminated bridges, Notre-Dame Cathedral, and the sparkling Eiffel Tower on a scenic one-hour glass-canopy boat tour.

attractions.name: Palace of Versailles
attractions.summary: An easy 40-minute RER train day excursion to King Louis XIV's opulent Hall of Mirrors and vast royal manicured gardens.

cultureEtiquette: Always greet shopkeepers and waitstaff with 'Bonjour' (or 'Bonsoir' after sunset) before speaking.
A 15% service charge (service compris) is included in restaurant bills by law; leaving an extra €1–€2 per person is customary for good service.
Keep your voice low on public transit and inside historic churches.
gettingAround: Contactless Navigo Easy card is the most economical way to ride the Metro and bus network.
RER B train connects Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) directly to central Paris in 35 minutes.
High-speed TGV rail connects Paris Gare de Lyon to Switzerland (Zurich/Geneva) in just 3 hours and 15 minutes.

itineraries.title: Right Bank Monuments & Eiffel Tower
activities: Stroll through Tuileries Garden and Place de la Concorde
Walk down Champs-Élysées to Arc de Triomphe
Sunset ascent of Eiffel Tower and evening Seine illumination cruise

itineraries.title: Left Bank Art, Gardens & Bohemian Quarters
activities: Explore Saint-Germain-des-Prés and historic Café de Flore
Walk through Latin Quarter and view Notre-Dame Cathedral

itineraries.title: Montmartre Charm & Versailles Excursion
activities: Morning funicular up to Sacré-Cœur and Montmartre artist square
Afternoon RER train excursion to the Palace of Versailles
Farewell dinner in a traditional French bistro in Le Marais

sustainability: Travel between European cities by high-speed electric TGV rail instead of short-haul flights.
Explore on foot or rent Vélib' shared electric bicycles across 1,000+ km of dedicated Paris bike lanes.
Refill reusable water bottles at the 1,200+ free sparkling and still water Wallace fountains across the city.

faqs.q: How many days are needed in Paris for first-timers?
faqs.a: A 4 to 5-day itinerary allows you to explore major landmarks like the Eiffel Tower, Louvre, and Montmartre without rushing, plus take a day trip to Versailles.

faqs.q: Do Indian citizens need a Schengen visa for Paris?
faqs.a: Yes, Indian passport holders require a valid Schengen short-stay tourist visa. Ghumo Firoo Travels provides end-to-end appointment scheduling, document verification, and flight/hotel reservation support.
